## TemplateEngine.validateBlockMapAttributes() method

Validates attributes on `<map>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockMapAttributes(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ valid: boolean; errors: Array&lt;{ line: number; message: string; }&gt;; }

An object with a `valid` boolean and an `errors` array

## Remarks

Allowed attributes are `src` and `join`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const result = TemplateEngine.validateBlockMapAttributes(`<map src="items" join=", ">{{e}}</map>`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }
```
